scripts/start-smto-manual.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Start the independent public SMTO manual with PowerShell.

Usage

./scripts/start-smto-manual.ps1 [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--reload]

Inputs

SMTO_MANUAL_PYTHON or .venv/Scripts/python.exe; AOR_MANUAL_HOST/PORT/RELOAD.

Side effects

Starts only the manual child; no dependency installation or other service.

Cleanup

Restore PYTHONPATH and propagate the child's exit status; console handles Ctrl+C.

@see src/manual/cli.py
